articles.title: Petrol, Diesel and LPG Prices Today: How the New Ujjwala Subsidy Cut Impacts Indian Households
articles.titleEn: Petrol, Diesel and LPG Prices Today: How the New Ujjwala Subsidy Cut Impacts Indian Households
articles.summary: The Indian government has reduced the number of subsidised LPG cylinders available under the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) from nine to four per year, while retaining the ₹300 subsidy per cylinder. The move comes amid rising global energy costs and growing losses for oil marketing companies. Domestic LPG prices have increased, putting additional pressure on household budgets, especially for low-income families.
articles.summaryEn: The Indian government has reduced the number of subsidised LPG cylinders available under the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) from nine to four per year, while retaining the ₹300 subsidy per cylinder. Domestic LPG prices have increased, putting additional pressure on household budgets, especially for low-income families.

articles.summary: Today Petrol, Diesel Price June 9: Fuel prices in India remain at their highest since May 2022, with petrol and diesel seeing cumulative hikes of around ₹7.5-₹8 per litre due to the West Asia conflict impacting global crude oil prices.
